site.name: KCCS
site.heroText: From farm-fresh produce to life-saving vaccines, KCCS keeps every pallet at the right temperature, from intake to delivery across Kabul.
site.aboutText: We keep produce, food and medicine safe from intake to delivery. Exporters, hospitals, NGOs and food businesses rely on us for storage plans built for the Afghan market.

services.title: Temperature-controlled storage
services.text: Rooms from −25°C to +15°C for produce, dairy and frozen goods.

services.title: Cross-docking & inventory
services.text: Handling, palletising, labelling and stock tracking.

services.title: Distribution & last-mile
services.text: Refrigerated delivery across Kabul and nearby provinces.

services.title: Pharmaceutical cold chain
services.text: Vaccine and medicine storage for hospitals and NGOs.

services.title: Produce & export handling
services.text: Pre-cooling, grading and packing for exporters.

services.title: 24/7 secure operations
services.text: Monitoring, generator backup, CCTV and guards.

faq.q: What is the minimum storage period?
faq.a: One month as standard. Weekly rates are available for caterers, exporters waiting for a shipment window, or urgent pharmaceutical storage.
Yes. Refrigerated delivery within Kabul, inter-provincial logistics through partners, and same-day delivery for urgent shipments with prior arrangement.
Our pharma chambers follow WHO and international cold chain standards, with continuous temperature logs, backup power and compliance documents.

faq.q: What happens in a power outage?
faq.a: Dual backup generators start automatically within seconds of a grid failure. Every event is logged with a timestamp.

faq.q: Do you serve clients outside Kabul?
faq.a: Yes. We work with clients across Afghanistan, including NGOs in remote provinces.
Yes. Book a tour and our operations team will walk you through the chambers and monitoring systems.
